validation.usernamePattern: may contain only letters, digits, "_" and "-", starting with a letter or digit
validation.timezone: must be an IANA time zone name

rejection.logStart: the first key did not start the countdown
rejection.keysAfterEnd: keys were recorded after the run ended
rejection.runTime: the run lasted longer than the time since it was issued
rejection.idle: the run was idle for too long
rejection.speed: the typing speed was implausibly high
rejection.progress: more was typed than the blocks reached could hold

errors.runTooOld: this run is too old to submit; play again
errors.contentChanged: the content changed since this run was issued; play again
errors.noRecord: there is no record for {{period}} to race
errors.tooManyAttempts: too many attempts; try again later
errors.serverProblem: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
errors.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check your connection.
errors.unexpectedResponse: The server sent an unexpected response.

auth.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. A phrase you can type is fine.

home.levelInvalid: enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}
home.ghostExplain: The Ghost types at the pace that scores exactly that record, and never misses. Beat it, and you have a new record.
home.noLanguages: No language is available to play right now.
home.footer: A run lasts 120 seconds over 20 blocks. The countdown starts with your first keystroke. The CPU never misses; a tie with it counts as a win.

play.statusReady: Start typing. The countdown starts with your first keystroke.
play.statusPlaying: Typing. Backspace is disabled; progress is forward-only.
play.overlayIme: Turn off your IME (Japanese input) to type.

result.noKeystroke: No keystroke was recorded, so nothing was saved.
result.idle: This run sat idle past the limit, so it was not saved.
result.tieWins: A tie counts as a win.
